blocks.text: KCA University Innovation Week and Industry Summit

KCA University, in partnership with COPYEK Projects, is proud to announce the upcoming Innovation Week and Industry Summit. This collaborative event aims to unite academia and industry players, aligning with COPYEK Projects’ objective of bridging the gap between academic knowledge and the practical skills required in the industry.
